extDescription.message: Connects your browser to the NAJD AGENT desktop app: it browses for you, finishes tasks and answers in a side panel. Local only.

tagline.message: Your personal agent, in your browser

connectBody.message: Link this browser with the NAJD AGENT app on this computer. NAJD will ask you to confirm in its own window. The link itself never leaves this computer.

searching.message: Looking for NAJD on this computer…

notFound.message: NAJD was not found. Open the NAJD AGENT app on this computer, then try again.

pairingBody.message: A window in NAJD shows the same code. Allow only if the codes match.

denied.message: The connection was declined in NAJD.

busy.message: Too many requests. Wait a few minutes and try again.

siteTitle.message: Allow NAJD to work on websites

siteBody.message: To browse and act in its own tab, NAJD needs access to the sites it opens for you. It works only in the NAJD tab group and only when you ask it to.

includePage.message: Share the address and title of this page

waitingApproval.message: NAJD is waiting for your approval in the app.

unconfirmed.message: The outcome is unconfirmed. Check before trying again.

askFailed.message: The question could not be sent. Is NAJD running?

tooMany.message: Too many questions in a minute. Wait a moment.

manualHint.message: Paste the code from NAJD Settings → Browser. It works once.

badCode.message: That code is not valid or was already used.

offlineHelp.message: NAJD is not running. Open it and this panel reconnects by itself.

privacy.message: This extension talks only to the NAJD app on this computer (127.0.0.1) and stores nothing in the cloud. Your questions are answered by the AI provider you chose in NAJD.

pageUnavailable.message: NAJD cannot read this page's address and title until website access is allowed (see above). Press Send again to ask without them, or untick the box.

answerTruncated.message: This answer is long: only its first part is shown here and copied. The complete answer is in the NAJD conversation.

selectionTooLong.message: The selected text is longer than NAJD takes (2,000 characters): only its beginning will be used. Press Send again to continue, or select less.
